newsitem.title: USA: Innovasive merges with Medicine Lodge.
newsitem.headline: Innovasive merges with Medicine Lodge.

text.p: Innovasive Devices Inc and privately held Medicine Lodge Inc Wednesday said they signed a definitive agreement to combine the companies in a tax-free reorganization in which Medicine Lodge's assets would be acquired for common stock of Innovasive Devices.
The companies said their boards unanimously approved an asset purchase agreement providing for the issuance of 1.885 million shares of Innovasive Devices common stock to Medicine Lodge.
Shares of Innovasive Devices dropped one to 9-1/8 in mid-afternoon trading Wednesday.

Headquartered in Logan, Utah, Medicine Lodge designs, develops and manufactures proprietary implantable medical devices and related instrumentation used in the minimally invasive arthroscopic procedures to repair injuries of the knee and shoulder.

The company said it is preparing to release a line of proprietary implants used to arthroscopically repair the anterior cruciate ligament of the knee, a surgical procedure currently performed on about 400,000 Americans annually.
